summary: One-shot initialization helper called during audio subsystem enter (caller 0x004C8A20). Runs an unconditional side-effect call (ArithmeticComparison_8350), then delegates with a literal argument 1 to ConditionalDelegation_7c10 and stores the returned status into global dword_8AC4C4. Returns BOOL true when that stored status is zero, i.e. success is reported as status == 0.

operations.description: Call ArithmeticComparison_8350() unconditionally with no stored result.
Store the int-cast result of ConditionalDelegation_7c10 into global dword_8AC4C4.
Return the comparison (dword_8AC4C4 == 0), i.e. true when the delegated call returned zero.

unresolved: Semantics of ConditionalDelegation_7c10's argument 1 and its return value meaning are caller-visible only from here.
Relationship between ArithmeticComparison_8350's side effects and the delegated status is not established.
